title: 惠民理财
music: rural Chinese drama underscore, erhu, pipa, plucked strings, rising tension, mid tempo, instrumental, no vocals
logline: The village chief lures everyone into a 300% 'farm finance' app; Xiaokang calls it a scam, the whole village turns on him, and he washes his hands of them.

clips.summary: Under {loc}, village chief {fugui} holds up his phone and boasts his 50,000 became 68,000 in twenty days; {cunmin} can't believe it.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling in the locust tree, a crowd murmuring, a rooster far off.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 我上个月投了五万，这才二十天，已经变成六万八了！
cuts.say: 我上个月投了五万……这才二十天，已经变成六万八了！
cuts.act: 得意洋洋，嗓门洪亮，故意卖关子
cuts.delivery: gloating, holding the phone high, gold tooth flashing
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui} holding up {phone_app}; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, craning to look.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 二十天赚一万八？这是真的假的？
cuts.say: 二十天赚一万八？！这是真的假的？
cuts.act: 瞪大眼睛，不敢相信，又惊又馋
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin} in the right two-thirds of the frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
cuts.action: {cunmin} pushes his straw hat back and gapes.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 年化收益百分之三百，投十万，一个月就是近三万！
cuts.say: 年化收益……百分之三百！投十万，一个月就是近三万！
cuts.act: 压低声音又突然拔高，像在推销
cuts.delivery: salesman's grin, tapping the phone screen
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, centre frame, the locust tree behind him.
cuts.action: {fugui} taps the screen of {phone_app} with his finger.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {dahua} pushes forward to invest her family's 100,000; the villagers crowd in with their phones; {xiaokang} pushes through and says it is not reliable.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling in the locust tree, a crowd murmuring, a rooster far off. Excited voices overlap.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 村长，我投！我家存折上正好有十万！
cuts.say: 村长，我投！我家存折上……正好有十万！
cuts.act: 挤出人群，抢着说，兴奋又急切
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua} pushing through the crowd, centre-left of the frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {loc}: a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, jostling forward holding up their phones, while {xiaokang} squeezes in from the edge.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} shoulders his way into the middle of the excited crowd.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 等等！大家听我说，这件事不靠谱！
cuts.say: 等等！大家听我说……这件事，不靠谱！
cuts.delivery: urgent, arms raised to stop them
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in the middle of the crowd, centre frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, turning toward him.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {dahua} sneers that {xiaokang} is a fly that lands on every good thing; he asks how any project can pay so much when the bank pays under three percent.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling in the locust tree, a crowd murmuring, a rooster far off.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 李小康，你是属苍蝇的吗？哪儿有好事你就往哪儿叮！
cuts.say: 李小康，你是属苍蝇的吗？哪儿有好事……你就往哪儿叮！
cuts.act: 脸一沉，尖酸刻薄地挖苦
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s shoulder blurs in the right foreground; {dahua} faces the camera in the left third.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 银行定期才不到百分之三，哪有这么高的收益？
cuts.say: 银行定期才不到百分之三……哪有这么高的收益？
cuts.act: 皱着眉，耐着性子讲道理，句尾追问
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre-right of the frame, dappled sunlight on his face.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {fugui}'s smile freezes and he asks if {xiaokang} is accusing him; old {erdaye} quietly tells Xiaokang to apologise; he refuses.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling in the locust tree, a crowd murmuring, a rooster far off. The crowd goes quiet.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 小康啊，你是在怀疑我骗乡亲们？
cuts.say: 小康啊……你是在怀疑，我骗乡亲们？
cuts.act: 笑容僵住，慢慢冷下来，话里带刺
cuts.delivery: smile freezing into a cold stare
cuts.action: {fugui}'s grin fades; he lowers the phone.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.act: 拐杖敲了下地，压低声音劝，着急
cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye} leaning toward Xiaokang, centre-left of the frame.
cuts.action: {erdaye} taps his cane on the ground and whispers.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我没错，我为什么要道歉！
cuts.say: 我没错……我为什么要道歉！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre-right of the frame.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {dahua} says the chief brought them a fortune and Xiaokang has no right to doubt him; {cunmin} says he just can't stand others getting rich; Xiaokang clenches his fists.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling in the locust tree, a crowd murmuring, a rooster far off. Angry muttering grows.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 村长给咱们村拉来这么大的项目，你有什么资格怀疑他？
cuts.say: 村长给咱们村拉来这么大的项目……你有什么资格怀疑他？
cuts.act: 上前一步，指着他鼻子，越骂越凶
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
cuts.action: {dahua} steps forward, finger pointed at his nose.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 自己没本事赚钱，还看不得别人发财！
cuts.say: 自己没本事赚钱……还看不得别人发财！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, right two-thirds of the frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, nodding.
cuts.action: {cunmin} spits to the side and sneers.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the jeering crowd blurred behind him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} clenches both fists, his eyes reddening.
cuts.camera: Static camera, slow push in, with small amplitude.

clips.summary: {xiaokang}'s inner voice remembers selling the village's unsold corn while the chief took the credit; {dahua} calls on everyone who wants to get rich to raise a hand.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling in the locust tree, a crowd murmuring, a rooster far off.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 去年玉米滞销，是我把玉米卖出去的，到头来功劳全算在了富贵头上。
cuts.say: 去年玉米滞销……是我把玉米卖出去的。到头来，功劳全算在了富贵头上。
cuts.act: 低沉的内心独白，苦涩，寒心
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in three-quarter profile under the tree, eyes lowered.
cuts.action: His eyes drop; he breathes out slowly.
cuts.end: The shot ends on his eyes in extreme close-up.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 想跟着村长发财的，举手！
cuts.say: 想跟着村长发财的……举手！
cuts.act: 振臂一呼，得意又挑衅地瞟他一眼
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
cuts.action: {dahua} throws her hand up and glances at Xiaokang.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: Everyone raises a hand, even {erdaye}, slowly; {xiaokang} asks if even he doesn't believe him, then says he will never again concern himself with their affairs.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling in the locust tree, a crowd murmuring, a rooster far off. The crowd falls silent.

cuts.composition: Medium shot under {loc}: hands shoot up all around while a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background; {erdaye} in the left third glances around and slowly raises his hand too; {xiaokang} in the right third stares at him.
cuts.action: {erdaye} raises his trembling hand, avoiding Xiaokang's eyes.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 二大爷！怎么你也不相信我？
cuts.say: 二大爷！怎么……你也不相信我？
cuts.act: 难以置信，声音一下子哽住
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre-right of the frame, eyes red.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} stares at the old man's raised hand.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 好，从今以后，你们的事我李小康不会再管了！
cuts.say: 好……从今以后，你们的事——我李小康，不会再管了！
cuts.act: 咬着牙，一字一顿，眼眶通红却没掉泪
cuts.delivery: jaw set, eyes red, every word final
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the raised hands of the crowd blurred behind him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} turns his back on the crowd.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.
cuts.end: He walks out of frame without looking back.
